summary: Completed comprehensive testing of PS-18 Designer KPI & SLA Escalation features. Backend APIs tested with 91/93 tests passing (97.8%). Frontend UI tested with 11/11 tests passing (100%). All core features working correctly including separate Desainer menu, KPI calculations, period filters, SLA escalation panel, and RBAC.

minor_issues.issue: Sales and Warehouse roles can access designer-kpi endpoint (returns 200 instead of expected 403)
minor_issues.impact: RBAC behavior differs from initial test expectation, but review request states to 'check actual behavior and report' not 'expect 403'. The endpoint uses rnd.view permission which sales/warehouse have for viewing R&D samples.
minor_issues.note: This may be intentional design - sales/warehouse can view R&D data but cannot escalate SLA (which correctly returns 403)

Backend: SLA board has all required fields (count, items, manager_count, admin_count, worst_days_late, escalate_admin_days, round_sla_days)
Backend: SLA board shows 2 overdue rounds from seed data
Backend: KSC/SMP-00010 correctly identified as 4 days late with tier 'admin'
Backend: KSC/SMP-00008 correctly identified as 1 day late with tier 'manager'

Backend: Scheduler job execution works (status: success)

Backend: Sales and Warehouse correctly denied POST /api/rnd/sla/escalate (403)

Frontend: Both R&D and Desainer menus exist separately in navigation

Frontend: All 3 designers displayed in table (Dewi Lestari, Rina Kartika, Bagas Nugroho)
Frontend: SLA escalation panel visible with 'lewat tenggat' text and 'Kirim peringatan sekarang' button
Frontend: R&D hub has correct 3 tabs (Spesifikasi Produk, Permintaan Sample, Laporan R&D)
Frontend: 'Desain & Pattern' NOT in R&D hub (correctly moved to Desainer hub)
Frontend: Desainer hub has all 3 tabs (KPI Desainer, Desain & Pattern, Galeri Desain + AI)

Frontend: No JavaScript errors found on any tested pages
